goals: Bypass only Polytone's custom textured leash RenderType and replacement vertices while retaining native Minecraft 26.2 leash geometry and light semantics.

Route only the leash feature through a complete Iris-compatible entity vertex contract while preserving Minecraft 26.2's native triangle-strip topology, geometry, light semantics, and leash-only scope.
Keep Polytone's established textured-leash material neutral at the vertex stage so its brown texture is not darkened a second time by Minecraft's untextured leash tint.
scope: Inject at the exact Polytone 26.2-6.3.1-fabric PolytoneRenderTypes fallback helpers, returning null and false so Polytone's custom textured-leash path remains disabled.

Adapt only Minecraft 26.2 LeashFeatureRenderer's buffer argument and vertex helper to a leash-only ENTITY-format TRIANGLE_STRIP RenderType, preserving the exact 26.2 forward/reverse pair sequence, slack curve, interpolated packed light, and a segment-derived normal; C4 intentionally uses a white vertex multiplier and no alternating 0.7 factor because Polytone's bound lead texture supplies the brown material color.

exclusions: Polytone source, binary, mixins, configurations, shader integration, textures, and every feature other than its custom textured-leash path.
Vanilla leash mechanics, attachment positions, physics, behavior, EntityRenderer and generic entity rendering, resource packs, Iris, Complementary, test-slot state, and both gameplay profiles.
